instanceAuthFormDesc.message:
Enter the credentials of the instance you want to authorize via the extension into the form. Then click the 'Link Device' button.
If you are already logged into your WhatsApp Web account, log out before authorizing the instance.
Do not close this window until the synchronization is complete!
